navaid.name: Cretehawser
navaid.description: The wreck site of the concrete Steam Tug Cretehawser. Built in 1919 and was dismantled in 1935. Hull was beached in the river in 1943

My intention here is to map a canal lock that has a footpath over the top of the lock. This is walkable, with a grippy surface and handrail. I tried following: https://c.osm.org/t/134349
Not traversable over the top (unless you were feeling brave) - just a gate, no footpath
